hero.title: House Renovation Services by Inland
hero.body: Want to give your home a fresh look or fix a structure that is no longer adequate? Inland is ready to help you realise your dream renovation, whether for an aesthetic upgrade, extra space, or structural repair.
hero.imageAlt: House renovation and storey extension by Inland

sections.title: Why Choose Inland for Your Renovation?

items.title: Personal Approach
items.text: Every renovation starts with understanding your needs — a living room refresh, a bigger kitchen, or a full overhaul. We design the right solution for you.

items.title: High-Quality Transformation
items.text: Neat, durable results with quality materials.

items.title: Experience Across Renovation Types
items.text: From light refreshes, facades, and kitchens to extra storeys and structural repair.

items.title: On-Time Delivery
items.text: Clear schedules and regular supervision keep renovations on time.

sections.title: Renovation Services We Offer
sections.imageAlt: Concrete slab rebar for a storey extension

items.title: Interior Renovation
items.text: Change your layout or update your interior with a focus on comfort, function, and beauty — from kitchens and bathrooms to family rooms.

items.title: Exterior Renovation
items.text: New facades, terraces, fences, carports, and roofs for a fresh look.

items.title: Extensions
items.text: Extra bedrooms, larger kitchens, or an added storey for a growing family.

items.title: Structural Repair
items.text: Fixing cracks, leaks, and strengthening structures so your home is safe again.

items.title: Older Home Restoration
items.text: Bringing older homes back to life while keeping their character.

items.title: Small to Large Renovations
items.text: Whether updating one room or overhauling the whole house, we have the right solution.

items.title: Facade Renovation
items.text: A more modern, attractive exterior while keeping the original structure.

items.title: Kitchen & Bathroom
items.text: Remodelling the two areas that are most often a renovation priority.

items.title: Older Homes
items.text: New life for older houses with structural repair and updated interiors and exteriors.

items.title: Initial Consultation
items.text: We discuss which areas you want to update, your budget, and your goals.

items.title: Renovation Plan
items.text: We prepare the design, scope of work, and a transparent budget.

items.title: Renovation Works
items.text: Our team works to schedule while keeping your home clean and safe.

items.title: Final Inspection & Handover
items.text: We inspect the result with you before handover.

items.q: What kinds of renovation does Inland handle?
items.a: Interiors, facades, kitchens and bathrooms, extensions or added storeys, structural repair, and restoration of older homes.

items.q: Can I stay at home during the renovation?
items.a: It depends on the scope. We plan the schedule and work areas to keep disruption to a minimum.
Yes. Our team surveys the site to assess the building before preparing the plan and budget.

sections.title: Your Dream Renovation Starts Here
sections.text: Ready to transform your home? Inland’s experienced team will help you renovate to your vision, budget, and needs.
